title: fix(plugin-grid): fold a row's inline primary action into its menu while the table overflows with it
body:

_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XHq9zDwuvUTBNrthT2ngEFS)_

Fixes #33230

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:列表行的主按钮(variant: primary)只在表格放得下它时内联显示;放不下就并进该行的「⋮」菜单顶部,右侧固定的操作列随之缩到只剩「⋮」。
- 为什么改:记录抽屉里放大的相关列表只有 622 px 宽,内联按钮让固定操作列宽一倍(139 px 对 68 px),表格因此溢出,固定列盖住最后一列「状态」。
- 风险与回滚:只动 plugin-grid 的行操作列宽度决策,不改协议、不改服务端;回滚即 revert 本 PR。全页列表放得下时行为不变,手机卡片布局不经过这段代码。
- 先看:objectGridInlineActionFold.ts(折叠规则与读数时机)、objectGridActionsColumn.tsx(折叠时内联预算取 0)、ObjectGrid.tsx(接线)。
- 两分钟验证:在本 PR 的 E2E chromium 检查日志里搜 related-list-pinned-actions,预期 drawer1440 / drawer1280 / drawer1024 三行都是 folded:true、inlineButtons:0,且 statusRight 不大于 actions.left;fullPage1440 一行 folded:false、inlineButtons:3。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`ObjectGrid` pins its Actions column to the right edge of the table's scroll box. A `variant: 'primary'` row action draws as an inline button beside the row's "⋮" trigger, and that button roughly doubles the pinned column. In a record drawer's enlarged related list the content is 622 px wide at the default drawer size, and the extra width alone turns a table whose data columns fit into one that overflows. The pinned column then sits over the last data column (Status) at rest.

The grid now draws inline row buttons only while the table fits its scroll box with them.

- When the table overflows with them, each row's primary action moves to the top of that row's "⋮" menu, through the row-menu planner with an inline budget of 0. No action is dropped, and the pinned column shrinks to the trigger.
- The buttons come back once the scroll box is at least as wide as the table was with them.
- Every reading waits until the table's size has held for two animation frames, because the table sizes its columns from what the cells drew over several passes, and a reading taken mid-pass sees widths it never settles at.
- The decision starts over (unfolded) whenever the rows or the column set change.
- The grid's host carries `data-row-actions-inline="folded"` while folded, so the state is readable in the DOM.

No export, prop or authored key changes. `maxInlineRowActions` stays a non-author surface.

**Producer, measured on origin/main before the fix.** It is the pinned column's width, not the scroll box's reservation. The box does reserve the column: its scroll width includes it, and scrolling to the end reveals Status. At rest, though, the 139 px column (with the inline button) covers the last data column, and `elementFromPoint` at the Status cell's centre answered the inline Allocate button (box 900 px, table 954 px, Status spanning 735 to 815 under the column from 761). Menu-only the column is 68 px.

## Tests

`ui/e2e/related-list-pinned-actions-width.spec.ts` mounts the real `RelatedList` enlarged face (then `object-grid`, `data-table` and the row menu) in Chromium, with Vite-bundled sources and compiled Tailwind, inside a frame of the drawer's or the list page's width. Reachability is read from layout with `elementFromPoint`, and the menu path is driven with real clicks.

- Drawer (622 px) at 1024, 1280 and 1440 px windows: the inline button is folded, the table no longer overflows, Status's cell and header are hit at their centres, Status ends at or before the Actions column's left edge, and Allocate dispatches from the "⋮" menu.
- CONTROL, full list page (1184 px at a 1440 window): not folded, three inline buttons, Status hit, and the inline click dispatches.
- CONTROL, 390 px: the card layout draws (no table scroll box, no fold mark), with Allocate in the card's menu.
- A table that overflows the drawer even menu-only: it folds too, and Status is reached by scrolling to the end.

## Acceptance notes

- When the table overflows the box even with the menu alone (many columns in a drawer), the folded "⋮" column still sits over the data at the box's right edge at rest, as on any list that scrolls sideways, including the full list page today. The fold makes room for every table that the inline button alone tipped over. Holding the line for a table that overflows anyway would need un-pinning the column or drawing columns narrower than their content, which is a separate design choice and not in this card.
- The card's figures (a 753 px reading against 623 px of scroll) do not add up to one table width, so this PR reproduced the defect from the drawer's measured content width (622 px at the default 720 px pane) rather than from those figures.
- The live showcase drawer has no enlarged related list to open (its authored page has no enlarge control), so the drawer width was measured live and the defect was reproduced and pinned in the browser harness above.

The workspace packages were built first (`turbo run build` over `./packages/*`, exit 0).

The first `ui` scripts run went red on one test, `e2e-type-check.test.ts` "imports no workspace package". The pin's page entry named `@object-ui/*` packages in its source string.
